purpose: Phase-6B APOPTOSIS INTERVENTIONS registry. Registry-driven, testable interventions (ROS scavenger, caspase inhibitor, AIF knockdown, PI3K activator) per cell-model profile. Consumed READ-ONLY. Interventions act on distinct targets; caspase inhibition affects ONLY the caspase branch, AIF knockdown ONLY the AIF branch, ROS scavenging acts UPSTREAM (before the commitment gate), PI3K activation restores survival signaling. Timing matters: an upstream intervention before commitment can prevent it; after irreversible commitment nothing reverses apoptosis. No drug concentration / scavenging rate / knockdown efficiency value is fabricated (strength is a qualitative class).

ros_scavenger.notes: ROS scavenging lowers oxidative stress -> lowers Bax/Bcl-2 pro-apoptotic shift + apoptotic pressure; can prevent commitment if applied early.

caspase_inhibitor.notes: B16 evidence: caspase inhibition only PARTIALLY attenuates apoptosis (AIF branch still executes). NOT complete rescue.

aif_knockdown.notes: B16 evidence: AIF knockdown STRONGLY attenuates apoptosis (dominant AIF-associated branch). Suppresses only the AIF branch.

ros_scavenger.notes: Transferred from B16; predictive in B16BL6.

caspase_inhibitor.notes: Transferred partial caspase dependence; predictive in B16BL6.

aif_knockdown.notes: Transferred strong AIF dependence; predictive in B16BL6.

ros_scavenger.notes: ROS scavenging lowers oxidative stress upstream.

aif_knockdown.notes: AIF branch suppression (mechanistic; B16-F10 AIF dependence not directly reported).

pi3k_activator.notes: PI3K activation restores AKT/mTOR survival signaling -> reduced apoptotic pressure. Supported in the B16-F10 context; NOT applied automatically to B16BL6.

intervention_rules.target_isolation: caspase_inhibitor affects ONLY the caspase branch; aif_knockdown affects ONLY the AIF branch; ros_scavenger + pi3k_activator act UPSTREAM (stress / survival).
intervention_rules.timing: Upstream interventions before the commitment gate can prevent commitment; after irreversible commitment nothing reverses apoptosis (execution branches may still be attenuated but the cell stays committed).
intervention_rules.no_pi3k_transfer: The PI3K-activator intervention is B16-F10-specific; applying it to B16BL6 would be a CONTEXT_TRANSFER_PREDICTION and is not enabled by default.
intervention_rules.no_fabricated_values: Strength is a qualitative class (partial/strong/complete); no concentration, scavenging rate, or knockdown-efficiency value is fabricated.
